fields.title: ExactSDS
fields.headline: AI for chemical-safety compliance
columns: Safety data sheets have to follow strict, region-specific chemical regulations. Writing and checking them by hand is slow and error-prone.
AI services behind FastAPI that combine several models, retrieval over historical safety data, and rule-based hazard classification.
Compliance comes first. Getting it right meant studying the regulations themselves: the global GHS standard and regional rules such as CLP and REACH in the EU and OSHA in the US.
fields.summary: AI-powered safety data sheet creation: several models, retrieval over historical safety data and rule-based hazard classification, built on close study of GHS, CLP, REACH and OSHA.
